capabilities: Open locked notes in reading view
Block editing with a strict lock
Lock or unlock several selected items at once
Manage and filter the list of locked items in settings
disambiguation: Not a security or encryption tool; it only prevents accidental edits inside Obsidian, not changes made outside it.
extras: Version 2.0 requires Obsidian 1.11 or newer and converts 1.x settings automatically, saving a copy as data-1.x-backup.json in the plugin folder. Lock icons in Notebook Navigator are experimental, off by default, and may break after Notebook Navigator updates. Locks live in the plugin settings file and sync with plugin settings; they do not protect against external edits, sync services, or other plugins writing files.
problem: Notes meant only for reading, such as archived or reference notes, can be changed by a stray keystroke while you are in editing mode.

relations.evidence: if you use the Notebook Navigator plugin, its right-click menu for notes, folders and several selected notes has the same options

summary: Plugin that opens notes or whole folders in reading view, with an optional strict lock that blocks editing until you unlock.
